subject.title: feat: heading-aware chunking + entity extraction for memory search

question: Should maintainers approve heading-aware memory chunking as a narrow deliverable now, and should it be default Markdown behavior or an opt-in strategy/config surface?
rationale: The source-visible chunking gap is concrete, but the requested entity extraction and graph-memory scope plus earlier config-heavy PRs require product/API direction before automation should implement it.

options.title: Approve Narrow Chunking First
options.body: Implement heading-aware Markdown splitting with oversized-section fallback and reindex/index-identity tests, leaving entity extraction and graph memory for separate Memory MVP work.

options.title: Require Strategy Design First
options.body: Keep fixed-size behavior as the only default until maintainers approve a chunking strategy/config contract and migration behavior.

options.title: Defer To Memory MVP
options.body: Wait for the broader Memory MVP memory schema, entity, and wiki synthesis direction before changing chunking semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Chunking First
recommendation.body: Implement heading-aware Markdown splitting with oversized-section fallback and reindex/index-identity tests, leaving entity extraction and graph memory for separate Memory MVP work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is closest to the current memory-host SDK chunking, indexing, and memorySearch config surfaces in recent history.
